caseName: Pond Creek Pocahontas Co. v. Alexander
caseNameFull: Pond Creek Pocahontas Co. v. Alexander, Chief of the Department of Mines of West Virginia

opinions.text:
Appeal from the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia.

Per Curiam:

Bierer, present Chief of the Department of Mines of West Virginia, substituted as a party appellee for Alexander. The appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question.
